meta.title: While others bid, a vendor's views carry nothing of them
gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/event_indicators, but the vendor's session may not call GET /v1/trade/:id/event_indicators (trade#event_indicators is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The available setup creates only one initially invited vendor and can add only QA vendor 2, not four QA vendors.
The before- and after-vendor-2-bid checkpoints cannot both be verified within the available operation limit.
The available read-back fields do not support searching every response for other vendors' names, company IDs, prices, or totals.
Only the absence of QA vendor 2's indicators data is directly asserted; other vendors' data cannot be checked.
what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)
warnings: verify 2: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendor2Uuid}}" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round for a second QA vendor.
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
As the invited QA vendor, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2” is absent.
As the invited QA vendor, read the event and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2” is absent; the read succeeds.
